Visitor replaces underline with custom markup

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_underline => fn(args) ->
        {:custom, "_" <> Map.get(args, "text", "") <> "_"}
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>This is <u>very important</u> text.</p>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result)
```
